Checks.Name: Data preserves object, scalar, array and null shapes
Arguments preserve spaces, quotes and shell-looking text
Native failure remains failure even with parseable JSON
Caller can explicitly accept a nonzero functional exit code
Missing executable returns a structured failure
Document capture overflow never parses a clipped document
Large concurrent stdout and stderr are drained with exact counters
Oversized stream record produces an uncertified failure
Parser failure drains the command without relaunch or raw fallback
Malformed machine output does not become a success
Timeout is distinct from capture and output limits
Known sensitive fields are masked and omissions reported
An oversized projection cannot exceed the final byte budget
Twenty assigned failures retain aggregate counters under 1 KiB
Oversized metadata cannot defeat the transport byte limit
Repeated emission of the same step envelope is not double-counted
An assigned timeout survives the final projection
Generated multi-stage script returns exactly one bounded document
